title: API Design Session
summary: James Cooper and Karen White discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for two weeks from now, but James Cooper's revised estimate is by the end of the quarter. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'two weeks from now' early in meeting, then revised to 'by the end of the quarter'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
defect_description: The same database migration task has two conflicting deadlines: 'two weeks from now' and 'by the end of the quarter'. The AI should flag the conflict rather than arbitrarily picking one.
